from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re,pandas as pd,numpy as np
d=Path('reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1');out=d/'sources'
protocol=json.loads((d/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));freeze=json.loads((d/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert hashlib.sha256((d/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==freeze['protocol_sha256']
recs=json.loads((d/'statement_source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
imgs=json.loads((d/'image_source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(recs)==16 and all(r['status']!='FAILED' for r in recs)
assert len(imgs)==3 and all(r['status']!='FAILED' for r in imgs)
transcribed={
 '2023Q3':{'months':['May-23','Jun-23','Jul-23','Aug-23','Sep-23','Oct-23'],'amounts':[[35,15,21],[32,12,18],[32,12,18],[38,16,23],[35,13,20],[35,13,20]]},
 '2023Q4':{'months':['Aug-23','Sep-23','Oct-23','Nov-23','Dec-23','Jan-24'],'amounts':[[38,16,23],[35,13,20],[35,13,20],[40,16,24],[37,13,21],[37,13,21]]},
 '2024Q1':{'months':['Nov-23','Dec-23','Jan-24','Feb-24','Mar-24','Apr-24'],'amounts':[[40,16,24],[37,13,21],[37,13,21],[42,16,25],[39,13,22],[39,13,22]]}}
manual={'method':'已打开本地原图逐行查看，仅转录已登记10/20/30年三列与六个月份，单位十亿美元。',
 'images':{r['quarter']:{'file':'sources/'+r['local_file'],'sha256':r['sha256'],'url':r['url']} for r in imgs},'transcription':transcribed}
(d/'三张原图长端列转录.json').write_text(json.dumps(manual,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
monthly=[];quarters=[];extracts=[]
for r in recs:
 q=f"{r['year']}Q{r['quarter']}";raw=(out/r['local_file']).read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
 soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,'html.parser');dates=list(dict.fromkeys(r['date_candidates']))
 assert len(dates)==1
 date=datetime.strptime(dates[0],'%B %d, %Y').date()
 available=pd.Timestamp(datetime(date.year,date.month,date.day,23,59,59,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))).tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai')
 if q in transcribed:
  months=transcribed[q]['months'];amounts=transcribed[q]['amounts'];method='原图逐行转录'
 else:
  tables=soup.find_all('table');assert len(tables)==1
  rows=[[c.get_text(' ',strip=True) for c in tr.find_all(['th','td'],recursive=False)] for tr in tables[0].find_all('tr')]
  headers=rows[0];assert all(x in headers for x in ['10-Year','20-Year','30-Year'])
  cols=[headers.index(x) for x in ['10-Year','20-Year','30-Year']]
  data=rows[1:];assert len(data)==6 and all(len(x)==len(headers) for x in data)
  months=[x[0] for x in data];amounts=[[float(x[c]) for c in cols] for x in data];method='HTML表格三列解析'
 parsed=[pd.Period(datetime.strptime(m.replace('Sept-','Sep-'),'%b-%y'),freq='M') for m in months]
 assert all(parsed[i]==parsed[0]+i for i in range(6))
 assert parsed[3].start_time.date()>=date.replace(day=1)
 assert all(v>0 for row in amounts for v in row)
 previous=float(sum(sum(x) for x in amounts[:3]));future=float(sum(sum(x) for x in amounts[3:]));growth=100*(future/previous-1)
 paragraphs=[p.get_text(' ',strip=True) for p in soup.find_all('p')]
 relevant=[p for p in paragraphs if any(x in p.lower() for x in ['table below','borrowing needs','nominal coupon','billion','pace and duration of future soma redemptions'])]
 extracts.append({'quarter':q,'url':r['url'],'date_text':dates[0],'field_unit':'十亿美元','relevant_body_paragraphs':relevant})
 for i,(m,values) in enumerate(zip(parsed,amounts)):
  monthly.append({'quarter':q,'month':str(m),'side':'prior_known_three_months' if i<3 else 'next_three_months_announced_plan',
   '10_year_bn':float(values[0]),'20_year_bn':float(values[1]),'30_year_bn':float(values[2]),'gross_long_bn':float(sum(values)),
   'statement_date_us':str(date),'available_at':available,'source_url':r['url'],'source_file':'sources/'+r['local_file'],'extract_method':method})
 quarters.append({'quarter':q,'statement_date_us':str(date),'available_at':available,'prior_start':str(parsed[0]),'prior_end':str(parsed[2]),
 'next_start':str(parsed[3]),'next_end':str(parsed[5]),'prior_long_gross_bn':previous,'planned_next_long_gross_bn':future,
 protocol['one_feature']:growth,'source_url':r['url'],'source_file':'sources/'+r['local_file'],'source_sha256':r['sha256'],
 'extract_method':method,'first_vintage_verified':False,'availability_type':'CONSERVATIVE_PUBLICATION_DATE_PROXY'})
qdf=pd.DataFrame(quarters).sort_values('available_at').reset_index(drop=True)
mdf=pd.DataFrame(monthly)
assert len(qdf)==16 and len(mdf)==96
qdf.to_parquet(d/'季度长端计划状态.parquet',index=False)
qdf.to_csv(d/'16季度供给增幅与来源.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
mdf.to_csv(d/'96月次长端原规模.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
(d/'正文规模与原因摘录.json').write_text(json.dumps(extracts,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
source_files=sorted(out.glob('*.html'))+sorted(out.glob('*.png'))
source_gate={'status':'PASS_FIXED_16_QUARTER_ORIGINAL_SCOPE_DATE_PROXY','statement_roots':16,'html_tables':13,'image_tables':3,'transcribed_long_amounts':54,
 'total_long_amounts':288,'source_objects':len(source_files),'requested_publication_years':[2022,2023,2024,2025],
 'all_16_sources_present':True,'all_prior_and_next_three_months_present':True,'observed_nonzero_growth_quarters':int(qdf[protocol['one_feature']].ne(0).sum()),
 'unique_growth_values':sorted(qdf[protocol['one_feature']].unique().tolist()),'first_vintage_verified':False,
 'gross_is_market_surprise':False,'gross_is_net_liquidity':False,
 'source_hashes':{str(p.relative_to(d)).replace('\\','/'):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in source_files},
 'quarter_field_hash':hashlib.sha256((d/'季度长端计划状态.parquet').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'manual_transcription_hash':hashlib.sha256((d/'三张原图长端列转录.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(d/'source_gate.json').write_text(json.dumps(source_gate,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(qdf[['quarter','statement_date_us','prior_long_gross_bn','planned_next_long_gross_bn',protocol['one_feature']]].to_string(index=False))
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in source_gate.items() if k!='source_hashes'},ensure_ascii=False))
